VERDICT PASS - PR #335
Head: 475a964c6bf7359b7442a56c19473a983451d91c

No security vulnerabilities found under C33/C34.

Reviewed env/bin/args from harness-alts.toml through launch, shell quoting and executable selection; configuration trust; alt names across CLI/store/tmux; and Claude-home hook/settings preservation. The configuration is operator-owned launch policy under C33, not a per-seat isolation boundary.

Round 2 reviewed the range-diff from 8966b780 to this head. The architecture metadata fixtures now include the new dependencies. At crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1404-1413, /new successor inheritance requires a verified predecessor with the same harness and exact PID/process-start identity, copies the stored alt unchanged, and does not overwrite an existing alt. No new env/argv construction is introduced.

Privacy: no personal account identifiers, email addresses, or machine-specific home paths found in added content, PR body, or commit messages. The /home/someone test and golden paths are synthetic fixtures.

Evidence:
- just pr-freeze 335: exit 0, FINAL at the full head above; remote/gh head agreement, CLEAN, every latest check passed.
- CI run 44966122135: success on the full head above; Rust tests, Rust lint, and both Node check jobs passed. The delivers check also passed.
- Local harness boot: advisory ready=false because the detached worktree has no TS dependencies.
- harness checks --quick --json: exit 1 from unavailable local TS tooling/ambient Biome mismatch; native Copilot and pij skill checks passed. Exact-head CI provides TS proof under C25; no dependencies were linked or installed.
- Scoped local shared-build attempt: exit 4 waiting for another worktree's build lock; no Cargo command or local Rust test ran.

Cost: no new timer, polling loop, or subprocess launch site. Config reads occur once per alt spawn, twice per alt revive, and once per Claude-home discovery. The existing binder selects the stored home without rereading TOML per tick. No live before/after measurements or production launches were performed.

The prime's live Claude-alt spawn/bind/revive canary remains a post-merge deployment check by the stated ruling; this verdict does not claim production proof.

Harness feedback: a dependency-free review evidence mode could report exact-head CI proof and privacy receipts without attempting missing local TS runners. Observation and magic-wand receipts are retained in the review's transient harness buffer; no unapproved feature work was started.
